sources.title: ICMR Diabetes Guidelines 2018
sources.summary: This project’s type 2 diabetes medicine records cite the 2018 ICMR diabetes guidelines for first-line Indian outpatient treatment context, including metformin and carbohydrate-absorption agents such as acarbose.

sources.title: ADA clinical guidelines
sources.summary: The synthetic patient–drug generator lists ADA clinical guidelines as a source used when assigning type 2 diabetes medicines to patient records.

sources.title: ICMR Hypertension Guidelines
sources.summary: Hypertension drug descriptions in the master dataset, including first-choice calcium-channel blockers such as amlodipine, cite ICMR hypertension guidelines as treatment-context support.

sources.title: JNC 8
sources.summary: The chlorthalidone record cites JNC 8 among the references used for hypertension treatment context in this dataset.

sources.title: ACR Guidelines
sources.summary: Disease-modifying arthritis medicines in this dataset—including methotrexate, sulfasalazine, and leflunomide—cite ACR guidelines as the clinical source for long-term rheumatoid arthritis therapy.

sources.title: ICMR
sources.summary: The prednisolone arthritis record cites ICMR as a source for short-term anti-inflammatory use while slower arthritis medicines take effect.
